title: Security Deposit at Closing and on a Move: Terms by Kind
content:
**Terms for customers who move or close an Electric Service account.** Whether a held Security Deposit follows the customer to a new service agreement, and the order in which a deposit applied at closing meets what is owed, are set for each kind as follows.

| Security Deposit kind | Held deposit moves with the customer to a new service agreement | Order in which a deposit applied at closing meets the final balance |
|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | Yes | Final bill first, then any other closed-agreement balance of the customer, remainder refunded |
| Residential Reestablishment Deposit | Yes | Final bill first, then any other closed-agreement balance of the customer, remainder refunded |
| Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit | Yes | Final bill first, then any other closed-agreement balance of the customer, remainder refunded |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | No | Final bill first, then any other closed-agreement balance of the customer, remainder refunded |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | No | Final bill first, then any other closed-agreement balance of the customer, remainder refunded |
| Large Power Service Deposit | No | Final bill first, then any other closed-agreement balance of the customer, remainder refunded |

## Conditions

1. A held deposit of the three residential kinds moves with the customer to the customer's new service agreement; a held deposit of the three business kinds does not.
2. For every kind, a deposit applied at closing meets the closing agreement's final bill first, then any other closed-agreement balance of the same customer, and only the remainder is refunded.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical Small Commercial Service Deposit of USD 900.00 with interest is applied when its agreement closes. The final bill is USD 620.00 and another closed agreement of the same customer carries an unpaid balance of USD 180.00. The deposit meets the USD 620.00 final bill, then the USD 180.00 balance, and the remaining USD 100.00 is refunded.
